# Purpose

Plan or run a single-chromosome NAM benchmark in which the same simulated
maize lines have breeding ancestry, irrigated/drought phenotypes, expression
data, eQTL truth, GWAS results, and genomic-selection outputs.

# Inputs

Use `analysis/paper_fig/fig12_maize_nam_chr10_gxe_multiomics.R`. The bundled
mode needs no external input. For an annotation-anchored run, require an
aligned founder FASTA, compatible `chr10` recombination map, and a matching
GFF3. Do not call a local GFF3 a real NAM founder panel by itself.

# Runnable Recipe

```r
system2("Rscript", c(
  "analysis/paper_fig/fig12_maize_nam_chr10_gxe_multiomics.R",
  "--out_dir", "analysis/results/maize_nam_chr10_gxe_multiomics",
  "--seed", "1201"
))
```

# Interpretation Boundary

The bundled focal feature and all QTL/eQTL effects are synthetic. The workflow
checks that data types remain linked by sample and truth; it does not validate
drought biology of a named maize line.
